title: Unit (plan unit entry)
description: One unit of a track plan, as add_unit takes it. Approving the plan creates the unit or revises it; the server assigns its number, state, revision, actor, via and timestamps, which are rejected here. The brief and the number of context items are also capped by the project's limits.

key.description: The unit's key in the plan, unique in the track.

control.description: Optional label of what the unit compares against. Cannery Row stores and shows it, and pins it on the verify job; the verifier's policy decides what it means.

acceptance.description: How the result is judged: splits, primary metric, required slices, criteria, regression gates and compute budget, checked against the project's metric registry.

required_slices.description: Dimension names, bare strings such as "language": the result must be reported for every value of each. The metric catalog lists each metric's dimensions with their values as {dimension, values}; acceptance names the dimensions only.

regression_gates.description: Dimension names or policy gate ids guarded against regression; free text for humans and the verifier.

compute_budget.description: Upper bounds the run must stay within: an object whose keys are <resource>_max (snake case, ending in _max) and whose values are non-negative numbers, such as {"gpu_hours_max": 4, "wall_clock_hours_max": 2}. At least one.

parameters.description: The project's own unit fields, checked against the science revision's unit_fields schema.

items.description: A typed relation to a unit of the project, of another project, or to another unit of the same plan.

oneOf.description: Number of a unit in the same project.
A unit in another project the caller can read.
The key of another unit of the same plan.

context.description: What the unit's performer should read.

unit.description: A unit number, or the key of a unit of the same plan.

brief.description: The unit's own text for whoever runs it, Markdown.
